title: サウジアラビアRCの後に・鴻鵠之志

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: We secured a place on the scoreboard, but…

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: No, we did not. And we will not be able to afford this kind of defeat on the road ahead.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Inexperience cost me this race. I admit it.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: But if we are to take the Classic Triple Crown, we cannot let this happen again.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Remember, those crowns are the least I must accomplish. Let us claim that first great goal without fail.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Next, we challenge the Satsuki Sho.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Just as we solidify our resolve to enter the Satsuki Sho…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Knock, knock…

text_block_list.name: Student Council General Manager
text_block_list.text: President, um…

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Ah, it's you again. What did you think of my performance?

text_block_list.name: Student Council General Manager
text_block_list.text: You were amazing… and so confident! You're way above the rest of us…

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Hm? Now, don't—

text_block_list.name: Student Council General Manager
text_block_list.text: Sorry! I-I didn't mean.. That is… I should be going!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Dash…

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Don't worry about it. I'll speak with her later.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Right now, we should review today's performance. Time is money, as they say, and it would not do to waste it.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Symboli Rudolf and I put our heads together for a while and review her race.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Just as we arrive back at the academy…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: VROOOOOM! Screeeeech!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Hm? An engine this loud could only mean…

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Heya, Rudolf!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Maruzensky. Just as I thought.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: A little birdie told me you're finally going for the Classic Triple Crown!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: That's one gnarly goal! I hope you pull it off! ♪

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It's Maruzensky the Beast, the so-called "Hot Rod" who has taken the world by storm, and made her debut even earlier than Symboli Rudolf.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: With the Emperor on one side and the Beast on the other, it's hard to hide my excitement as a trainer. And yet…

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Gnarly… hmmm. Perhaps… no, that's not funny enough.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: You're not trying to turn that into a pun, are you?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: You could pull a muscle doing that.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: I thought it might be a worthy challenge… as well as a potent addition to my arsenal if I could pull it off.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Hey, not cool! You can't just take the things I say and turn them into gags!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Haha… My apologies.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The two seem like they're on good terms. I can't help but notice that Symboli Rudolf looks a little more relaxed in Maruzensky's company.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Oh, shoot! Gotta dash! I'm keeping the teacher waiting!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: I think the school found out about me using an employee parking spot.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: I mean, it's not like anyone else was using it! What's the problem, right?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Are you certain you want to ask the president of the student council? You might not like the answer.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Aw, man… Why do you have to such a square?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Guess I'd better be going. Hasta la vista, baby!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Haha… As energetic as ever.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: I see her as less of a friend and more as… an object of interest, one might say.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: As you are surely aware, her effortless strength is causing quite the stir in the racing world.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: I regard her as a worthy contributor to the future I mean to build.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: And besides, I find her… intriguing.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: She stirs my most basic racing instincts.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: I think of myself as drawing strength from many things. My dreams, my ideals, the expectations of the students I lead.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: But I cannot help but wonder… if I were to meet her on the track, fueled only by my thirst for victory, who would prevail?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Which of us would truly prove the strongest?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: For just an instant, something shines in her eyes, but it quickly fades.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: But I have a long way to go before I'm qualified to speak of such things.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Now then, I ought to get back to work. I'm going to return to the academy. Is that all right?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: But of course. There is always more to be done. If that is all, then I will take my leave.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: If she were to race against Maruzensky as she is now—a racer pursuing an ideal—she would undoubtedly compete as the "Emperor."

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: But after today, a part of me hopes that someday she has the chance to compete simply as Symboli Rudolf instead.
